newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisnave surges as wins repair orders.
newsitem.headline: Lisnave surges as wins repair orders.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese ship repairer Lisnave-Estaleiros Navais de Lisboa rose 11 percent to 277 escudos on optimism over new orders won by the company, dealers said.
"The immediate target for Lisnave is 300 escudos, and this is possible because the company is obtaining new repair contracts," one operator said.
Another said: "Lisnave managed to win various repair contracts for the coming months, and this is good news for the company."
Lisnave closed at 273 escudos, up 23, in volume of 226,750.
